prompt: Create exactly ONE game sprite animation sheet containing exactly SIX isolated depictions of the SAME single falling English oak, elongated blade with 4 pairs of soft rounded lobes leaf, muted ochre yellow. Reference 1 is project-owned leaf brushwork only, reference 2 is project seasonal palette only. SIX frames arranged in ONE straight horizontal row, equally spaced centers, transparent background, no labels no borders no ground no text. Each frame has only ONE leaf and short petiole. Flutter rotation around stable leaf center: frame0 broadside front; frame1 yaw45deg oblique narrow; frame2 nearly edge-on slender curling blade; frame3 underside broadside tilted other way; frame4 oblique narrow reversed; frame5 broadside front tilted approaching frame0. Actual 3D pitch/yaw causes clearly differing widths, not six flat copies rotated in image plane. Maintain identical leaf shape, length and color identity across frames. Soft top-left light, muted hand-painted medieval English city-builder style, no thick outline, no glow, crisp readable broad form, minimal vein detail. Each frame has ample transparent padding, leaf centers on same horizontal line, no frame touches another. Designed for final six 16x16 frames with blade length 8-10 pixels (whole sheet96x16): broad simplified silhouette, not a detailed botanical illustration. Use large consistent negative gutters between six sprites, no second row. True RGBA transparent output.
